title.narrative: Over five years, Somalia expanded MNCH services across 310 health facilities, delivering 7.85M consultations and 382K skilled deliveries. Malaria prevention reached 5.3M people, HIV treatment supported 5,089 individuals, and major infrastructure upgrades including oxygen plants and national laboratories strengthened health systems for women, children, and vulnerable communities nationwide.
